User Story

As a system user

I want to be able to create new Collection channel in the system

So that I will have possibility to conduct payment process correctly

Design: https://xd.adobe.com/view/d4f196e5-7d0a-4dc9-a6c0-e4c374af9713-81a2/

Acceptance Criteria

  1. Creating a Collection channel is possible from Collection channel’s listing page by clicking on a ‘Plus’ button

  2. Clicking on Plus button will open Collection channel creation page

  3. Check system user permissions to be able to create new Collection channel

    1. Permission - Create Collection channel

    2. Enable the Plus button when the user has permission

    3. Disable the Plus button when a user doesn’t have permission

  4. Clicking on a Plus icon on the Collection channel listing page will open the Collection channel creation page

  5. For creating a new Collection channel all mandatory fields should be added 

  6. Default state of Collection channel object contains fields: 

    1. Name

      1. Mandatory

      2. The name should be unique on the system level

        1. For example, if there is already created object with name - Collection1, it is not possible to create second object with the identical name

      3. Text field

      4. Length: 1 - 512 characters

      5. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

    2. combine liabilities

      1. check box

      2. optional

    3. Type

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown

      3. Hardcoded values:

        1. Offline

        2. Online

    4. Employee/Group for error notification

      1. Optional

      2. Single select dropdown

        1. In the dropdown should be list of all active system users and tags, which start by Group prefix.

        2. After selecting a group, all system users who have that group tag will get notification (without needing to display individual users).

        3. Dropdown should be sorted alphabetically.

    5. Collection partner

      1. Mandatory

      2. Single select dropdown 

      3. List is manageable from nomenclature

        1. Active values will be returned from the nomenclature 

        2. Only the name should be displayed

        3. Order should be considered

        4. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

          1. It is possible to search the Collection partner by its name

        5. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

        6. Display default if returned from nomenclature

      4. Number of Income account

        1. Mandatory

        2. Text field

        3. Allowed symbols: A-Z a-z 0-9

        4. Length: 1-512 characters

      5. Currency

        1. Mandatory

        2. Single select dropdown 

        3. List is manageable from nomenclature

          1. Active values will be returned from the nomenclature 

          2. Only the name should be displayed

          3. Order should be considered

          4. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

            1. It is possible to search the coordinator for balancing groups only by its name

          5. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

          6. Display default if returned from nomenclature

      6. Customer conditions

        1. Radio buttons:

          1. Mandatory

          2. Hardcoded values:

            1. All customers

            2. Customers under conditions

            3. List of customers

          3. Selecting 'All Customers' option means to include all the customers existing in the system in the collection channel

            1. Deleted customers shouldn't be included

          4. Selecting 'Customer under conditions' option enables conditions section and it is possible to define details for the customer and according to defined conditions system should include such customer in the collection channel

          5. Selecting 'List of customers' option enabled List of Customers text box and it is possible to define Customer IDs and include them in the collection channel

        2. Customer Conditions

          1. Section is enable and mandatory only when the 'Customer under conditions' option is selected

          2. Section is disable and empty when 'All customers' or 'List of customers' option is selected

          3. Conditions logical operators:

            1. = equality operator. Return true if condition 1 equals to condition 2. Return false if condition 1 does not equal condition 2.

            2. > Greater then operator. Return  true if condition 1 is greater than condition 2. Return false if condition 1 less/equal then condition 2.

            3. <less then operator. Return true if condition 1 is less then condition 2. Return false if condition 1 is more/equal then condition 2.

            4. <> not equality operator. Return true if condition 1 does not equal to condition 2. Return false if condition 1 equals condition 2.

            5. In attribute. Return true if condition 1 equals one of the value from list which is added in attribute. Return false if condition 1 does not equal one of the value from list which is added in attribute

            6. Should have brackets after attribute, to separate more than one value in brackets use comma

            7. And logical operator. Return true if condition 1 and condition 2 both are true. Return false if condition 1 or condition 2 is false.

            8. Or logical operator. Return true if condition 1 or condition 2 are true. Return false if condition 1 and condition 2 are false.

            9. Not attribute. Can be used before any condition and should have brackets after attribute. Return the opposite Boolean of condition

            10. () brackets. Can be used for identification which condition should be checked firstly.

            11. Validate. Validate formula format and displays error if format is wrong.

          4. Variable dropdown

            1. Single select dropdown

            2. Mandatory

            3. Values should be different in the Values dropdown according to the chosen variable

            4. Variable list:

              1. Contract

              2. Product

              3. Service

              4. Product Type

              5. Service Type

              6. Customer Type

              7. Grid operator

              8. Contract Type

              9. Measurement Type

              10. Voltage level

              11. Purpose of consumption

              12. POD type

              13. Interim and advanced payment

              14. Segment

              15. Customer number

            5. Values dropdown

              1. In the values dropdown values should be filtered according to the chosen variable with the following logic:

              2. If Contract is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

                1. Product Contract

                2. Service Contract

              3. If Product is selected as a variable, system should display all the product list in the dropdown with its name and if they are inactive after the name in brackets to be written (inactive)

                1. System shouldn't display deleted product in the dropdown

                2. It should be possible to search product with its name

                3. Products list should be sorted with its creation date

              4. If Service is selected as a variable, system should display all the services list in the dropdown with its name and if they are inactive after the name in brackets to be written (inactive)

                1. System shouldn't display deleted services in the dropdown

                2. It should be possible to search services with its name

                3. Services list should be sorted with its creation date

              5. If Product Type is selected as a variable, system should display all the active values from the Product Type nomenclature

              6. If Service Type is selected as a variable, system should display all the active values from the Service Type nomenclature

              7. If Customer Type is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

                1. Legal

                2. Private

              8. If Grid Operator is selected as a variable, system should display all the active values from the Grid Operator nomenclature

              9. If Contract Type is selected as a variable, system should display four hardcoded values:

                1. Combined

                2. Supply and balancing

                3. Supply only

                4. Without supply

              10. If Measurement Type is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

                1. By settlement period

                2. SLP

              11. If Voltage Level is selected as a variable, system should display four hardcoded values:

                1. Low

                2. Medium

                3. Medium - direct connected

                4. High

              12. If Purpose of Consumption is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

                1. Household

                2. Non-household

              13. If Interim and Advance Payment is selected as a variable, system should display

                1. Yes

                  1. If YES option is selected, it means that the product/service which is connected to the contract has interim and advance payment added

                2. No

                  1. If NO option is selected, it means that the product/service which is connected to the contract does not have interim and advance payment added

              14. If Segment is selected as a variable, system should display all the active values from the Segment nomenclature

              15. If POD type is selected as a variable, system should display two hardcoded values:

              16. Consumer

              17. Generator

              18. If Customer Number is selected as a variable, Values dropdown should be disabled and system shouldn't display any values in it

                1. If user selects Customer number as a variable, then in the text box should define additional details in order to start process correctly.

                  1. For example, if there is a condition: (Customer number > 0000000001)AND(Customer number<0000000007), system should take all the customer with numbers in this range and start process for them

        3. List of Customers

          1. Disabled and empty when 'All customers' or 'Customer under conditions' option is selected

          2. Enable and mandatory when 'List of customers' option is selected

            1. Text box

            2. Allowed symbols: All symbols are allowed, should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

            3. Length: 1-8196 characters

            4. In this text box user should define customer identifiers and selected documents according to the type will be blocked for those customers

            5. If incorrect format of customer ID is defined in the text box, return error

      7. Exclude liabilities by Prefix

        1. Optional

        2. Multi select dropdown

        3. List of values should be displayed from the Prefix nomenclature

        4. In this text box user should define prefix value according to the prefix nomenclature, in order to exclude document which was created based on defined prefix connected invoice/debit note

          1. For example, customer has 10 invoices - 5 of them are product contract based and 5 of them are service contract based. In this text box user has defined prefix for the product contract invoices. As a result, system should not include liabilities created based on the product contract invoice, because its prefix is defined here and only the liabilities which are created on the service contract invoice bases will be included.

      8. Exclude liabilities by amount

        1. This section includes two related fields:

          1. Less than

            1. Optional

            2. Text field

            3. Allowed symbols: 0-9 . ,

            4. Length: 1-10 characters, 2 digits after the decimal point

            5. Less than <= Greater than

          2. Greater than

            1. Optional

            2. Text field

            3. Allowed symbols: 0-9 . ,

            4. Length: 1-10 characters, 2 digits after the decimal point

            5. Greater than >= Less than

          3. Amounts defined in this section should be taken into account within the selected Currency in this object

      9. Priority of liabilities by prefix

        1. Optional

        2. Multi select dropdown

        3. List of values should be displayed from the Prefix nomenclature

        4. In this text box user should define prefix value according to the prefix nomenclature, in order to give priority to the liabilities which were created based on defined prefix connected invoice/debit note

          1. For example, customer has 10 invoices - 5 of them are product contract based and 5 of them are service contract based. In this text box user has defined prefix for the product contract invoices and document type selected in the object is liability. As a result, system should give priority to the product contract based liabilities.

      10. Type of File

        1. Mandatory when type is Offline

        2. System shouldn’t display Type of File dropdown at all, when object’s type is Online

        3. Single select dropdown

        4. Hardcoded values

          1. Payment Partner

          2. Bank Partner

      11. BANK

        1. Mandatory when type is Bank partner

        2. Disabled and empty when type is Payment partner

        3. Text box (All options should be included)

        4. Nomenclature

        5. Enable and mandatory when type of file is bank partner

        6. multi select dropdown

      12. Data sending schedule

        1. Optional

        2. Text field

        3. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

        4. Length 1-2048 characters

        5. In this section, user should define RRULLE formula

        6. If invalid formula is added should display error message

      13. Data receiving schedule

        1. Optional

        2. Text field

        3. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

        4. Length 1-2048 characters

        5. In this section, user should define RRULLE formula

        6. If invalid formula is added should display error message

      14. Number of working days for waiting payment

        1. Enable when the Data sending schedule is filled and type of file is bank partner

        2. Disabled when Data Sending Schedule is not defined

        3. Optional

        4. Text field

        5. Length: 0 - 999 (3 characters)

        6. Allowed symbols: 0-9

      15. Calendar

        1. Mandatory and enable if Number of working date is filled

        2. Disabled - If Number of working date is not defined

        3. Single select dropdown

        4. List is manageable from nomenclature

          1. Active values will be returned from the nomenclature

          2. Only the grid operator’s name should be displayed

          3. Order should be considered

          4. Display Search Bar if number of items are more than 10 items in dropdown list

            1. It is possible to search the grid operator only by its name

          5. While typing search letter list in dropdown should be filtered by search letters

          6. Display default if returned from nomenclature

      16. Waiting period tolerance in hours

        1. Optional

        2. Text field

        3. allowed symbols: 0-9

        4. Length: 0-99 characters (2 characters)

      17. Folder for file receiving

        1. Visible and optional if type is offline

        2. Disabled if type is Online

        3. Text field

        4. All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

        5. Length: 1-2048 characters

      18. Folder for file sending

        1. Visible and optional if type is Offline

        2. Disable if type is Online

        3. Text field

        4. all symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

        5. Length: 1-2048 characters

      19. Email for file sending

        1. Visible and optional if type is Offline

        2. Disable if type is Online

        3. Text field

        4. allowed symbols: standard email validation

        5. Length: 1-2048 characters

      20. Clicking on 'Save' button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

        1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new Collection channel and display it in the listing page

        2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

        3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

      21. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button warning pop-up message should appear: 'Are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

        1. Yes - will close pop-up and user is returned to the listing page

        2. No - will close pop-up and user stays on the current page

        3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

      22. Audit Log should be created
